# Package map

Every importable package in `m31labs.dev/gosx`, grouped by layer. The [guides index](README.md) points to the guide for each topic; [stability tiers](STABILITY.md) explains the tier column.

## Layers and import direction

Layers run from the bottom up. A package may import its own layer and the layers listed before it in this table, subject to the extra rule in the second column. Browser-side and tool packages are special cases. A test (`scripts/pkgmap`) enforces the order and that no library imports a tool package, except for the known edges in `scripts/pkgmap/layer_exceptions.txt`; each is a place where the code does not yet follow the rule. The browser-side rule is enforced by `game/deps_test.go`.

| Layer | Rule |
|---|---|
| Foundations | Imports no other GoSX layer. |
| Kernels | No hub, server or route. |
| Scene and compiler | No server, route or hub. |
| Web primitives | No server or route. |
| App server | No game stack. |
| Game stack | May import any layer before it. |
| Browser side | Builds for js/wasm. No root package, hub, net/http or parsers. |
| Tools | CLI, desktop host, evidence and test packages. No library imports them. |

Four nested modules keep heavy dependencies out of the core module: `editor`, `netplay/webrtc`, `game/teamai/arbiterrules` and `cmd/buildbootstrap`. See [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md).

## Foundations

| Package | Tier | js/wasm | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | internal-use | yes | Defines page commands: named actions with keyboard chords that the opt-in workbench runtime dispatches and mirrors into aria-keyshortcuts. |
| `controller` | internal-use | yes | Defines GoSX's declarative headless browser controller contract. |
| `crdt` | experimental | yes | Conflict-free replicated documents with a bloom-filter sync protocol. |
| `crdt/encoding` | experimental | yes | Binary encoding of crdt changes and documents. |
| `crdt/sync` | experimental | yes | The crdt sync message, bloom filter and peer state. |
| `css` | stable | yes | Provides lightweight CSS scoping for GoSX components. |
| `det` | experimental | yes | Provides floating-point math that gives the same bits on every platform GoSX targets: js/wasm in the browser, amd64 on a server, and arm64 on Apple Silicon. |
| `det/lint` | experimental | yes | The GoSX deterministic-code analyzer. |
| `det/parity` | experimental | yes | Records and compares per-step state hashes of a simulation, so that one run on js/wasm, amd64 and arm64 can be shown to give the same bits. |
| `env` | stable | yes | Loads .env files for GoSX applications. |
| `highlight` | stable | yes | Provides syntax-highlighting helpers for GoSX, Go, and common docs-site snippet languages. |
| `markup` | stable | yes | Builds GoSX node trees and renders them to HTML, without the GoSX compiler. |
| `oceanspec` | experimental | yes | Computes the swell waves of the Scene3D spectral ocean. |
| `query` | internal-use | yes | Provides type-safe binding between URL query parameters and Go structs — the "URL as a first-class, typed state container" pattern. |
| `ratelimit` | internal-use | yes | Provides bounded admission shared by HTTP and realtime handlers. |
| `signal` | stable | yes | Provides reactive state primitives for GoSX island components. |
| `textlayout` | stable | yes | Text measurement, line breaking and ellipsis, with browser-measured and approximate measurers. |

## Kernels

| Package | Tier | js/wasm | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `assetpipe` | experimental | yes | Inventories Scene3D-ready project assets, describes the build-time optimization work GoSX should perform before those assets ship, and runs the part of that work GoSX can do in pure Go. |
| `assetpipe/gltfedit` | experimental | yes | Reads a glTF 2.0 or GLB document, rewrites mesh primitives, and writes a new GLB. |
| `assetpipe/hdrimage` | experimental | yes | Decodes high dynamic range images into linear float32 pixels. |
| `assetpipe/ibl` | experimental | yes | Builds image-based lighting products from a linear high dynamic range environment image. |
| `assetpipe/manifest` | experimental | yes | Defines the file `gosx assets build` writes and the runtime side reads. |
| `assetpipe/meshopt` | experimental | yes | Encodes glTF buffer views for EXT_meshopt_compression. |
| `assetpipe/meshoptim` | experimental | yes | Reorders and merges mesh index and vertex data. |
| `assetpipe/meshsimplify` | experimental | yes | Reduces triangle meshes with the quadric error metric of Garland and Heckbert. |
| `assetpipe/quantize` | experimental | yes | Turns floating point vertex attributes into small integers and reports the error the change introduces. |
| `assetpipe/texture` | experimental | yes | Builds GPU-ready raster texture variants in pure Go. |
| `assetpipe/texture/bc7` | experimental | yes | Encodes and decodes BC7 texture blocks in pure Go. |
| `assetpipe/texture/bcn` | experimental | yes | Encodes 4x4 block-compressed textures: BC1, BC3, BC4 and BC5. |
| `assetpipe/variantsel` | experimental | yes | The capability vocabulary that asset variants and the server's fidelity verdict share. |
| `engine` | stable | yes | Provides the runtime for GoSX engine components. |
| `engine/host` | stable | yes | The transport-neutral half of an engine host: the part of an engine that publishes views to a page and answers its calls, with no knowledge of how the page is reached. |
| `engine/surface` | stable | yes | Provides first-class canvas engine surface support for GoSX. |
| `engine/surface/runtime` | stable | yes | The surface engine runtime registry. |
| `field` | experimental | yes | Provides a 3D vector field type with trilinear sampling, standard operators (advection, curl, divergence, gradient, blur, resample), per-component scalar quantization with delta encoding, and hub streaming. |
| `island/program` | stable | yes | Binary serialization for IslandProgram (prod mode). |
| `motion` | experimental | yes | Provides a unified animation evaluator for GoSX. |
| `motion/animgraph` | experimental | yes | Drives skeletal animation for Scene3D models from Go. |
| `motion/animgraph/gltfclip` | experimental | yes | Reads animation clip names and durations from a glTF 2.0 asset (.glb or .gltf) so an animgraph.Graph can declare its clips without hand-typed durations. |
| `physics` | experimental | yes | A deterministic rigid-body simulation. |
| `physics/hubrunner` | experimental | no | Drives a physics world from a gosx hub through the server-authoritative sim runner. |
| `vessel` | experimental | yes | A deterministic model of a large powered displacement ship: a cruise liner, an expedition ship, a megaship. |

| Package | Tier | js/wasm | What it is |

| `render/compute` | experimental | yes | The render-coupled-compute extension surface for the GoSX renderer: the GPU Resource Bus (a typed descriptor over render/gpu buffer and texture handles) plus the ExternalComputePass hook (see pass.go) that lets out-of-tree systems — Elio-generated kernels today, in-frame Eos inference later — record compute passes onto the frame's command encoder and publish their outputs as render inputs. |

| `render/gpu/stub` | experimental | no | Provides a non-WASM implementation of gpu.Device that returns ErrUnsupported from every constructor. |

| `scene/capability` | stable | yes | The single source of truth for which Scene3D rendering backend can faithfully render a given feature set. |
| `scene/earcut` | stable | yes | A faithful Go port of mapbox/earcut, the canonical ear-clipping polygon triangulation library (https://github.com/mapbox/earcut). |
| `scene/geom` | stable | yes | Generates the triangles of every built-in GoSX geometry. |
| `scene/harness` | stable | yes | Provides an interactive, browser-free Scene3D test session. |
| `scene/imagediff` | stable | yes | Compares two rendered frames and reports where they differ. |
| `scene/inspect` | stable | yes | Counts and inspects scene geometry and assets, for budgets and tooling. |
| `scene/preview` | stable | yes | Renders typed GoSX Scene3D scenes without a browser, WebGPU, or a platform graphics driver. |

## Game stack

| Package | Tier | js/wasm | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `game` | experimental | yes | Provides a first-class runtime foundation for interactive simulations, games, and scientific visualizations in GoSX. |
| `game/actions` | experimental | yes | Maps keyboard, mouse, pointer-lock and gamepad input onto named game actions. |
| `game/actions/bridge` | experimental | yes | Publishes action state from package actions to a game.Input, so systems that read game.Input see the same actions. |
| `game/audio` | experimental | yes | A small WebAudio bus graph and one-shot player for a browser game client. |
| `game/audio/host` | experimental | yes | Exposes typed browser audio nodes and lifecycle controls without importing the game runtime or manifest player. |
| `game/audio/kernel` | experimental | yes | Hosts a WASM audio kernel, such as Cicada's music engine, in an AudioWorklet and routes its output to a mixer bus. |
| `game/audio/speech` | experimental | yes | Builds spoken commentary for games the way classic sports games did: pre-recorded phrase fragments stitched together live. |
| `game/audio/speech/loudness` | experimental | yes | Measures and normalizes mono speech clips: ITU-R BS.1770-4 loudness, 4x true peak, silence trimming, a peak-safe limiter, resampling and WAV reading and writing. |
| `game/audio/speech/voice` | experimental | yes | Plays speech.Sequencer timelines on the mixer's voice bus. |
| `game/audio/speech/voicerender` | experimental | yes | Turns a speech.RenderManifest into voice clips: it asks a text-to-speech Provider for each phrase variant, trims silence, normalizes loudness, packs the clips into one atlas per voice and writes the clip manifest the runtime loads. |
| `game/audio/worklet` | experimental | yes | Supplies GoSX's browser processor for WASM audio reactors. |
| `game/boot` | experimental | yes | The loading and readiness gate of a game. |
| `game/boot/bootpage` | experimental | yes | Renders the server-side parts of the boot gate: preload links for the Go WASM module and its wasm_exec script, and a small JavaScript watchdog that runs before the framework scripts. |
| `game/camera` | experimental | yes | Camera rigs, poses and a director for game cameras. |
| `game/flow` | experimental | yes | Runs a game's top-level states (boot, title, lobby, play, pause, results) as a stack, and ties the stack to the simulation pause flag and to the input context stack. |
| `game/gamepad` | experimental | yes | Polls the browser Gamepad API and feeds the result into a game.Input's existing bindings. |
| `game/host` | experimental | yes | Provides typed browser gamepad snapshots and animation-frame ownership without depending on game.Runtime, server hubs, or the compiler. |
| `game/kitui` | experimental | yes | Renders the screens every game needs (pause menu, settings, key rebinding, loading, error) as GoSX nodes. |
| `game/loop` | experimental | yes | Owns the browser's requestAnimationFrame driver so a game does not have to call js.FuncOf/requestAnimationFrame itself. |
| `game/netsync` | experimental | yes | The client side of package room: it connects a GoSX game to a server-authoritative room, predicts the local player on a local copy of the simulation, and reconciles with the server's snapshots. |
| `game/physicsys` | experimental | yes | Connects the physics package's gameplay features to game.Runtime: it drives character controllers at the fixed step and delivers trigger events to game code. |
| `game/replay` | experimental | yes | Records a deterministic game cheaply and plays it back with scrubbing, pause, slow motion and step controls. |
| `game/replay/replayui` | experimental | yes | The replay viewer's controls: a Controller that turns keyboard, mouse and gamepad actions (package game/actions) into player and camera commands, and a Bar that renders the scrubber, speed picker, camera picker and marker list as GoSX nodes in the look of package game/kitui. |
| `game/serve` | experimental | no | Holds the server-side helpers of package game: driving a game.Runtime from a sim.Runner over a hub, and mounting a runtime's engine in a server-rendered page. |
| `game/settings` | experimental | yes | Holds the player's options: audio bus volumes, motion and camera-shake preferences, render scale, frame cap, quality tier, key bindings and language. |
| `game/storage` | experimental | yes | A small, typed key/value persistence wrapper for a browser game client. |
| `game/teamai` | experimental | yes | A deterministic toolkit for team and squad AI: formations, timed paths, steering and interception, an assignment executor driven by rules, and seeded contest resolution. |
| `netplay` | experimental | yes | A transport-agnostic rollback netcode engine and relay for deterministic two-player simulations. |
| `netplay/client` | experimental | yes | The browser (Go WASM) side of GoSX netplay transport. |
| `netplay/cmd/netplay-identity` | experimental | yes | Computes a simulation identity and writes it as a Go file. |
| `netplay/dgram` | experimental | yes | Holds the fixed-slot datagram queue that netplay network transports use between their I/O goroutines and the game loop. |
| `netplay/hubnet` | experimental | yes | Carries netplay signaling and fallback datagrams over a GoSX hub WebSocket. |
| `netplay/signal` | experimental | yes | Defines the WebRTC signaling messages that netplay peers exchange over a GoSX hub WebSocket. |
| `room` | experimental | yes | A server for online multiplayer GoSX games. |
| `room/advance` | experimental | yes | Runs scheduled, per-group jobs for long-running online leagues: "advance the round when every human match is finished, or when the deadline passes". |
| `room/group` | experimental | yes | Keeps named persistent groups (a league, a clan, a season) and their members in a room/store. |
| `room/identity` | experimental | yes | Gives players a lightweight identity without accounts. |
| `room/mode` | experimental | yes | Describes a playable game mode for package room (server) and package game/netsync (client): how many seats it has, how to build its simulation, and how a bot plays a seat. |
| `room/roomtest` | experimental | yes | A tiny generic game for testing and demonstrating package room and package game/netsync: every seat steers one body around a bounded arena, and optional props drift and bounce. |
| `room/store` | experimental | yes | A small durable key-value and append-log store built on the Go standard library. |
| `room/wire` | experimental | yes | The binary protocol between a room server (package room) and its clients (package game/netsync). |
| `sim` | experimental | yes | Provides server-authoritative game simulation over gosx hubs. |
| `sim/simcore` | experimental | yes | Holds the parts of package sim that need no hub: the Simulation contract, the per-player Input a tick receives, and deterministic input ordering. |
